name: Associated Bus Company Plc (ABC Transport PLC)
source: ABC Transport Plc audited consolidated and separate annual report and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, filed with the Nigerian Exchange (NGX disclosure library), Group column, read in full on 25 September 2026: statement of financial position page 19, statement of profit or loss page 20, statement of cash flows page 23 and the five-year financial summary page 89 | key alias copy from ABCTRANS (same security, older symbol)

rows.label: Capital Expenditure
rows.derivedFrom: printed purchase of property plant and equipment plus printed purchase of intangible assets, both negative, so this row is stored negative

note: Rebuilt 25 September 2026 from the audited FY2025 report of the issuer, Group column, statement of cash flows page 23. Every row is a printed figure. Operating plus investing plus financing cash flow equals the printed net change in cash in both years, and the printed closing cash equals the balance sheet cash and equivalents line. The five-year financial summary of the issuer prints no cash flow statement, so FY2023 to FY2021 are blank.
alias_basis: ABC Transport Plc was formerly Associated Bus Company Limited and the Nigerian Exchange lists the security only under ABCTRANS, so this key resolves to the same security under an older symbol
periods_note: columns dropped: FY2023, FY2022, FY2021 - no row in this file carries a figure for them, so they rendered as pure dashes
